correctness.rationale: The two discarded multiples of 3 in inclusion–exclusion are zero mod 3^(k+2) from the stated starting index, compensating exactly for v_3(720)=2. Every length-2·3^k late block gives one full t-block on each parity. For A=log25, B=log16, C=log4, the reductions mod 27 are (24,15,21), obtained by truncating the logarithm after its cubic term. The even branch's coefficient of t is 1 mod 3 and all nonlinear coefficients vanish mod 3, by m−1−v_3(m!)≥1 for m≥2. For g=f_1/3, the linear numerator is −5A+10B+5C=0 mod 27, the t² coefficient is 2 mod 3, and the t³ numerator after removing 3³ cancels mod 3 by the cube congruence. For m≥4, m−2−v_3(m!)≥1 by Legendre's bound. These estimates also ensure restricted convergence. Thus g' is an isometry with a unique zero α in 3Z_3; translating the restricted series and factoring s² leaves U(s)=u mod 3 coefficientwise, where u=g''(α)/2 is 2 mod 3. The unit square root in 1+3Z_3⟨s⟩ follows by convergent binomial expansion, so s√(U(s)/u) is an isometry (identity plus 3 times a restricted integral series), not just a local approximation. Also g(α)=1/40 mod 9, giving δ=21 mod 27. The even branch contributes one per target; the odd branch has three lifts per lower-depth square root, including k=1. Even-valuation square classes, scaled Haar measure and the modulo-three count (four out of six) give the other claims. Fresh recurrence-only checks at nonaligned blocks n=7..60 (k=3) and n=8..493 (k=5) matched all finite branch profiles; these tests do not determine the high digits of u, which is defined canonically by the derivative. evidence: As in Kwong, the shifted column series has denominator f_6(x)=∏_(i=1)^6(1−ix). Any eventual period d gives polynomiality of (1−x^d)/f_6(x) modulo 3^k, and hence divisibility of 1−x^d by the factors (1−2x) and (1−x)(1−4x) over that ring. The first evaluated mod 3 forces 2|d. Canceling 1−x using (1−x^d)/(1−x)=Σ_(j=0)^(d−1)x^j and evaluating at 1/4 forces 3^k|d since the sum there has valuation v_3(d) by the unit lifting formula.

Other inspected Stirling congruence and p-adic results do not give this square-folded branch distribution. The exact binomial-polynomial analogues concern different maps.
